headline: Origin Enterprises Delivers Double-Digit Revenue Rise on High Fertilizer
summary: Irish agri-services group Origin Enterprises reported double-digit revenue growth driven by surging global fertilizer prices ahead of its capital markets presentation in London.
why: Fertilizer and agricultural input pricing drives input cost margins for commercial farming groups and revenue growth for agribusiness suppliers.

impacts.name: Origin Enterprises
impacts.why: Surging fertilizer market prices boosted top-line revenue growth across Origin's operating divisions.
